status.description: "running" is written to disk immediately before the model process is invoked (execution_mode "cli" only), so an attempt that never reaches a terminal status -- e.g. killed by a power loss or crash mid-run -- still leaves a permanent record in run_info/ rather than nothing at all. Overwritten in place with "success"/"failed" once the attempt finishes.

execution_mode.description: "cli" if `run`/`run-all` executed the model; "manual" if the model was run outside the CLI and this record was produced by import-manual-run to curate outputs after the fact.

framework_commit.description: Git commit SHA of this repo itself at the time of the run.

driver_script.description: Source path of the driver script staged into the working folder for this run -- relative to calibration_runs/ if a custom driver_script was declared, or relative to the TDM submodule root (e.g. 'Scenarios/_default/__HailMary_1Subfolder.s') if the framework default was used. Absent only for execution_mode 'manual'.

status_source.description: How run status was decided. "model_log" means the TDM's own _Log\_RunTime.txt completion report was found and used (preferred). "exit_code" means no recognizable log entry was found yet. Absent for execution_mode "manual".

model_log.description: Parsed from the TDM's own _Log\_RunTime.txt. Absent when that file/entry wasn't found.

general_parameters.description: Present only when this calibration run declared general_parameter_overrides. Records the GeneralParameters.block overrides applied via the per-run override file/extra READ FILE described in src/tdmcalib/general_parameters.py -- a separate mechanism from control_center's overrides above.

scenario_folder.description: The run's working folder inside the TDM submodule (Scenarios/{calib_run_id}/).

seeded_from.description: Identifies the prior run whose raw working folder was copied into this one before Control Center rendering, when this run declared start_from_copy.

committed.description: False when this file exceeded the calibration run's max_file_size_mb -- it was still written to repo_path locally (e.g. for rendering reports on this machine) but is listed in its outputs/ folder's auto-generated .gitignore and was never committed to the repo.

preprocess.description: Result of tdmcalib.postprocess.build_report_cache() building this run's runs/{calib_run_id}/cache/*.parquet (report/preprocess/) before rendering. Absent when the run itself did not succeed.

postprocess.description: Result of tdmcalib.postprocess.render_validation() re-rendering the report/ Quarto project after this run. Absent when the run itself did not succeed (nothing new for a report to show).
